title: bidens mannii
intro: Bidens mannii, commonly known as African beggarticks, is a plant species in the daisy family that is native to tropical Africa. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Bidens mannii include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Bidens mannii contribute to its therapeutic actions, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
